description.zh: 从一次博弈中背叛占优，到重复博弈、循环赛、继续概率阈值 δ* 与三策略复制者动态，再到噪声下宽容的价值。两人两动作、固定收益 5/3/1/0、无突变的简化模型。
description.en: From defection dominating a single round, through repeated play, a round-robin, the continuation threshold δ* and three-strategy replicator dynamics, to the value of forgiveness under noise. A simplified two-player, two-move model with payoffs 5/3/1/0 and no mutation.

label.zh: 占优策略的反例式应用

reason.zh: 第 0 步的收益矩阵里背叛是占优策略，却使双方都不如合作，是博弈论“占优均衡不一定最优”的经典例子。
reason.en: In step 0’s payoff matrix defection is dominant yet leaves both worse than cooperating, the classic case that a dominant-strategy equilibrium need not be best.

reason.zh: 第 4 步的复制者动态让得分高的策略比例上升，与自然选择“适合度高者占比增加”是同一种数学。
reason.en: Step 4’s replicator dynamics let higher-scoring strategies grow in share, the same mathematics as fitter types increasing under natural selection.

title.zh: 为什么合作能在自私者中存活？
title.en: How can cooperation survive among selfish players?

note: game-theory and natural-selection are page slugs; coordinator may remap to atlas node ids if they exist.
